visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a long black ponytail and a large black bow is dancing on a vibrant green baseball field. She is wearing a purple and black baseball jersey with 'Monkeys' written across the front, which is tied at her waist to reveal her midriff. She also wears black denim shorts and tall black boots that reach her knees. She holds a black microphone in her right hand, moving it rhythmically as she performs energetic dance steps. Her facial expression is one of pure joy and concentration. The background consists of the out-of-focus green grass of the stadium. (2) The scene cuts to a slightly different angle and moment. The woman continues her performance with a wide smile, her eyes sparkling with excitement. She turns frequently, displaying the number '51' and the name 'LanLan' on the back of her jersey. Her movements are sharp and synchronized with the upbeat tempo of the background music. At various points, a cameraman with professional equipment and a performer with an afro hairstyle playing an electric guitar appear in the frame, adding to the professional stage-like setting established on the field. (3) The camera captures more dynamic and expansive movements from the performer, including high leg kicks and wide arm circles. She interacts with the unseen crowd, pointing and gesturing to build excitement. The natural daylight provides bright and even illumination, highlighting the textures of her clothing and the sheen of her hair. The setting is clearly an outdoor baseball stadium, with the dirt of the infield visible in the background. The text 'Monkeys' is clearly visible on the jerseys of the performers. (4) The performance concludes with the woman and the guitarist striking a final, high-energy pose together. She continues to sing with great intensity, her mouth wide open as she hits the final notes. Her ponytail swings wildly with her movements. The overall atmosphere is highly festive and celebratory. Other people, including staff and possibly other performers, are seen in the far background, contributing to the sense of a large-scale public event.
